class.name: PDFTexture
class.brief_description: A texture imported from a single PDF page.
class.description: The Windows x64 editor can import a [code].pdf[/code] file as a [PDFTexture]. Select the page and DPI in the Import dock, then use the resource anywhere a [Texture2D] is accepted. Exported projects load the baked pixels without PDFium.

members.member: The resolution in dots per inch used to render the imported page.
The imported page number, starting at 1.
